environmentSummary.creationStartingPoint: Create Player flow reached from Road to Glory setup
environmentSummary.appearanceEntryPoint: Create Player > Player > Appearance > Head & Skin
environmentSummary.captureFormat: MP4, 1920x1080, h264 Main, AAC audio, approximately 58.96 fps

creationPathInstructions.displayName: Road to Glory Custom QB Create Player appearance path

steps.instruction: Open College Football 27 main interface and navigate to Road to Glory.
steps.visibleMenuLabel: College Football hub / Road to Glory navigation

steps.instruction: On Road to Glory Setup, choose Advance.
Select the observed journey type card highlighted before the position screen.
Choose QB on the position screen.
steps.expectedResult: QB is selected and the flow can continue toward Create Player.
Create Player opens on the Player top tab.

steps.instruction: Open or observe Player Info from the Player tab.
steps.expectedResult: Player Info fields are visible, including Handedness as a field.

steps.instruction: Open Appearance from the Player tab.
Observe Head & Skin in the Appearance submenu.
steps.expectedResult: Head & Skin is visible and selected.
Hair is visible as a sibling row; Hair is not opened in this footage.

currentOpenRequests.exactMenuPath: Xbox Settings > System > Console info; Xbox Settings > System > Updates; Xbox Home > College Football 27 tile > Manage game and add-ons; College Football 27 title/version screen if visible
currentOpenRequests.whyRequired: Current evidence cannot prove the exact Xbox environment, game executable, patch/update state, edition, entitlement, or account context required for a versioned catalog release.

currentOpenRequests.exactMenuPath: College Football 27 main interface > Road to Glory > Road to Glory setup > Journey type selection > Position selection > QB selection > Create Player > Player
currentOpenRequests.whyRequired: The catalog must tie appearance recommendations to a reproducible creation path and player setup context.

currentOpenRequests.exactMenuPath: Create Player > Player > Appearance > Head & Skin, then Create Player > Player > Appearance > Hair
currentOpenRequests.whyRequired: All catalog records need stable parent menus, native order, control type, scrolling evidence, locks, and warnings.

currentOpenRequests.exactCategory: Head Template count and native order
currentOpenRequests.exactMenuPath: Create Player > Player > Appearance > Head & Skin > Head Template
currentOpenRequests.whyRequired: The current head-template evidence has skipped numbers, duplicate observations, and no proven final selector boundary.

currentOpenRequests.exactMenuPath: Create Player > Player > Appearance > Head & Skin plus Create Player > Player > Appearance > Hair controls that visibly affect eye black, hairstyle obstruction, or facial hair
currentOpenRequests.whyRequired: Standardized head and geometry comparison requires locked obstruction, hair, facial-hair, zoom, lighting, and framing conditions.

currentOpenRequests.exactMenuPath: Create Player > Player > Appearance > Head & Skin > Head Template
currentOpenRequests.whyRequired: Every head candidate needs standardized menu and angle evidence before annotation, measurement, second verification, or production approval.

currentOpenRequests.exactMenuPath: Create Player > Player > Appearance > Head & Skin > Skin Tone
currentOpenRequests.whyRequired: Current Skin Tone evidence has unknown total count, missing observed range values, and no wrap/default proof.

currentOpenRequests.exactMenuPath: Create Player > Player > Appearance > Head & Skin > Skin Details
currentOpenRequests.whyRequired: Current Skin Details evidence is directly observed but count/boundary/default/wrap proof is missing.

currentOpenRequests.exactMenuPath: Create Player > Player > Appearance > Head & Skin > Eye Shape
currentOpenRequests.whyRequired: Eye Shape count and boundaries remain unknown, and the current footage may be affected by eye black.

currentOpenRequests.exactMenuPath: Create Player > Player > Appearance > Head & Skin > Eye Color
currentOpenRequests.whyRequired: Eye Color needs readable native labels, full selector proof, and representative frames with sufficient resolution.

currentOpenRequests.exactMenuPath: Create Player > Player > Appearance > Head & Skin > Nose
currentOpenRequests.whyRequired: Nose is geometry-relevant and current evidence lacks reliable profile views and selector boundaries.

currentOpenRequests.exactMenuPath: Create Player > Player > Appearance > Head & Skin > Ear Shape
currentOpenRequests.whyRequired: Ear Shape needs side evidence, hairstyle-obstruction review, and complete selector boundary proof.

currentOpenRequests.exactMenuPath: Create Player > Player > Appearance > Head & Skin > Mouth Shape; then Jaw Shape; then Chin
currentOpenRequests.whyRequired: Mouth, Jaw, and Chin are required geometry controls but have no option records yet.

currentOpenRequests.exactMenuPath: Create Player > Player > Appearance > Hair
currentOpenRequests.whyRequired: Hairstyles, hair colors, facial hair, and facial-hair colors need exact native menu location before option capture.

currentOpenRequests.exactMenuPath: Create Player > Player > Appearance > Hair > exact visible hairstyle control recorded in GFM-CAP-014
currentOpenRequests.whyRequired: Hairstyles are required appearance recommendations and can obstruct head/ear evidence.

currentOpenRequests.exactMenuPath: Create Player > Player > Appearance > Hair > exact visible hair-color control recorded in GFM-CAP-014
currentOpenRequests.whyRequired: Hair color is a separate recommendation surface and must not be guessed from generic color names.

currentOpenRequests.exactMenuPath: Create Player > Player > Appearance > Hair > exact visible facial-hair control recorded in GFM-CAP-014
currentOpenRequests.whyRequired: Facial-hair presence and style are required appearance recommendations and must include None if available.

currentOpenRequests.exactMenuPath: Create Player > Player > Appearance > Hair > exact visible facial-hair-color control recorded in GFM-CAP-014
currentOpenRequests.whyRequired: Facial-hair color may be independent from hair color and cannot be assumed.

currentOpenRequests.exactMenuPath: Create Player with baseline from GFM-CAP-005; test Head & Skin, Hair, Player/body controls one variable at a time
currentOpenRequests.whyRequired: Production catalog records must know whether options vary by mode, platform, body setup, account state, entitlements, patch, or other controls.

currentOpenRequests.exactMenuPath: Same paths as GFM-CAP-001 through GFM-CAP-018, performed independently by the second verifier on the same shipping-game environment where possible
currentOpenRequests.whyRequired: No record may become production verified without genuine second-person verification and discrepancy handling.

currentOpenRequests.exactCategory: Operator context slates and backup evidence
currentOpenRequests.exactMenuPath: Any capture session used above; begin and end with a full-screen context slate showing game mode, menu path, and clip purpose where safe
currentOpenRequests.whyRequired: Nice-to-have provenance that makes tomorrow imports easier and reduces relabeling risk.

allowedStatusDefinitions.VERIFIED: Second verifier agrees that the scoped record satisfies mandatory evidence checks. Use only after independent review and required sign-off.
allowedStatusDefinitions.VERIFIED_WITH_NOTES: Second verifier agrees with documented limitations or non-blocking notes. Requires manager acceptance before publication.
allowedStatusDefinitions.RECAPTURE_REQUIRED: Evidence is insufficient or ambiguous and a new capture is required.
allowedStatusDefinitions.MISSING_EVIDENCE: Required evidence is absent or cannot be resolved.
allowedStatusDefinitions.COUNT_MISMATCH: Verifier count differs from the primary observation.
allowedStatusDefinitions.ORDER_MISMATCH: Verifier native order differs from the primary observation.
allowedStatusDefinitions.DEPENDENCY_UNRESOLVED: A dependency, lock, entitlement, mode, or path condition remains unresolved.
allowedStatusDefinitions.NOT_VERIFIED: Default state. No second-person verification has occurred or completed.

randomizedSecondaryAngleSamplingMethod.summary: For each category, hash environment_id + verifier_id + catalog_version with every eligible catalog ID, sort by SHA-256 hash, and select the first required quartile.
